title: Pholio Trust Registry verification entry
description: One curated match between a row in a committed public-registry snapshot and an organisation Pholio knows about. Every registry-derived field must reproduce the snapshot row verbatim; the validator checks that, so a fabricated certificate number cannot reach the database.

registry.description: Closed vocabulary, mirrored in src/shared/constants/submission-tracker.js. A registry is only listed once a snapshot of it is committed under raw/.

rawSnapshot.description: Pack-relative path of the snapshot this entry was curated from. The validator reads it and byte-compares every registry-derived field.

organizationId.description: Spec Registry organisation slug (scope.organization.id). Null for an entry that only names a live Pholio agency.

agencyId.description: Live Pholio agencies.id. Null for a reference entry, which by definition has no agencies row.

legalName.description: Verbatim business_name from the snapshot row.

dba.description: Verbatim dba from the snapshot row, or null when the row publishes none.

certificateNumber.description: Verbatim certificate_number. Half of the (registry, certificateNumber) natural key the sync upserts on.

officialApplyUrl.description: Taken from the matching spec-pack revision's scope.channel.url when one exists — never invented here.

evidenceUrl.description: Where the snapshot came from, so a reader can re-pull it.

retrievedOn.description: When the registry rows were pulled.

verifiedOn.description: When a human matched that row to this organisation. A different claim from retrievedOn, and the only one the talent-facing copy shows.
